summary: Host configuration can be baked into the OS image, but when it is missing, device-specific or must change at runtime without a reboot, declare configuration files that the agent applies atomically (all succeed or roll back); OS updates are applied before config sets, and multiple config sets apply in order with the last one winning on conflicts.
questions: When should I use Edge Manager config files instead of a new image?
Are Edge Manager configuration updates atomic?
What happens if I update OS and configuration together?
Which configuration set wins on a conflict?
